config.Enable this mod.name: Enable Mod
config.Storage Space Pattern.name: Storage Area Style
config.Storage Space Pattern.description: Changes the appearance of the added map. The number of usable tiles also varies depending on the selected style.
config.BoatTexture.name: Boat Appearance
config.BoatTexture.description: Choose the boat appearance. (This only affects the boat shown when Beach Extension For Crab Pod is not installed.)
config.LowChroma.name: Low Saturation
config.LowChroma.description: Reduces the boat's color saturation. If you're using a recolor mod and the boat looks out of place, enabling this option may help it blend in better. (This only affects the boat shown when Beach Extension For Crab Pod is not installed.)
config.Scaffolding for swim mod.name: Swim Mod Compatibility
config.Scaffolding for swim mod.descript: Edits part of the fence to prevent players from getting stuck when entering the ocean with Swim Mod while using a style other than Scaffolding Only. This option can also be enabled when using the Scaffolding Only style.
